Body.Content: Use Azure Automation (now in public preview) to create, monitor, deploy, and maintain resources in your Azure environment. It automates time-consuming, error-prone, and frequently repeated cloud operations tasks (for both Azure and third party systems). Visit Scott Guthrie’s blog and the Automation page to learn more about Automation and how to get started.
